rules.title: Rockville ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices and shared competitor information
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use algorithmic devices or shared competitor information to set rent, fees, or other rental terms.

coverage.summary: The only available source, a secondary alert, does not state coverage limits, exemptions or penalties.

rules.effective_date_note: Effective January 1, 2027, per the August 21, 2026 Morgan Lewis alert's summary table. It is not yet effective as of the 2026-10-01 query date.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits landlords from using algorithmic devices and shared competitor information to set rent, fees, or other rental terms.
rules.review_note: The rule is supported only by a secondary law-firm alert (DX06). The ordinance text, ordinance number, enactment date, definitions, exemptions and penalties are not captured. Verify these against the official Rockville City Code before relying on them.
rules.source_notes: Source is the Morgan Lewis LawFlash 'Algorithmic Rent-Pricing Litigation Expands Under New State and Local Laws' (Aug. 21, 2026), jurisdiction summary table. The alert separately lists Montgomery County, Maryland as having a pending measure. That is a different jurisdiction and is not part of this rule.
